How the repo rate reaches your pocket 🚇💸

In September the Reserve Bank lifted the repo rate to 7.25%, and prime followed to 10.75%. On a R1 million, 20-year bond that's about R10,152 a month, and every 0.25% hike adds around R170. Savers earn a little more; borrowers pay more.

Next rate decision: 19 November. Hike or hold? 👇

Education, not financial advice.
